issues.description: Field name mismatch in the Person model: the template and tests expect a field named 'firstName' (with corresponding getFirstName()/setFirstName()), but the solution's Person.java declares the field as 'forename' while retaining accessors named getFirstName()/setFirstName() that reference 'firstName'. This causes a compilation error in the solution (accessors refer to a non-existent field) and creates a confusing divergence between template, tests, and solution implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across template, tests, and solution. The simplest fix is to rename the field in solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java from 'forename' to 'firstName' so it matches the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName() accessors and the tests. Alternatively, rename the accessors (and update all call sites/tests) to use 'forename' consistently, but prefer restoring 'firstName' to avoid broad changes.
